icon:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: square app icon for a real low-poly first-person gym simulator, for Yandex Games.
Create one finished 512x512 PNG icon (square composition). A single powerful human forearm and anatomically clear hand firmly gripping one heavy black hexagonal dumbbell, the fist and dumbbell dominate the central 70% and form an extremely readable silhouette at 64 pixels. Warm tan skin, matte charcoal weights, a thin cyan highlight on the metal. In the background a dim compact neighborhood gym with dark rubber floor, cyan fluorescent strip, a little warm orange light and a simple squat rack, softly out of focus but visibly an actual low-poly gym.
Style: crisp chunky low-poly 3D game key art, restrained facets, strong directional lighting, energetic and tactile. A confident lift caught mid motion. Not photorealistic, not a cartoon mascot. Closely based on the game's actual activity: growing first-person arms and weight training.
Composition: tight dynamic three-quarter angle, no overly cropped fingers or weights; all crucial detail within centered circular safe area of radius 40% of image width. Background fills all edges. No frame, no rounded corners. No text, no numbers, no arrows, no buttons, no UI or progress meters, no logos, no watermarks. No giant superhero, no face, no medals or objects implying absent features. One arm and one dumbbell only.

Create a striking low-poly 3D gym-simulator cover in a coherent art direction with warm faceted skin, charcoal iron and cyan light. In first-person perspective, two believable adult forearms hold a heavy black barbell in a compact neighborhood gym. The barbell and a large near weight plate dominate the right two-thirds in a dynamic closeup, with squat racks, simple gym benches, dark rubber tiles and cyan fluorescent ceiling strips filling the scene. The viewer should feel the effort of one more rep. Restrained simple low-poly models, not realistic photographs, not superhero proportions, no separate full-body character.

"Качалка:"
"ещё один"
"повтор"
Text has clean orange accent on the final line, plenty of breathing space and is clear at small thumbnail size. Use sentence case exactly as provided. The text and scene balance so weights and hands remain the main visual hook. No other text. No UI, progress bars, arrows, buttons, level badges, numbers, icons, play triangles, platform logos, watermarks, framing or rounded corners. Strong readable silhouette, cinematic warm side light and cool cyan rimlight, restrained visual detail. Keep all title letters inside a 7% safe margin. Horizontal composition 800:470.
